description: Search and filter official YesNoMystery puzzles and public password-free community (UGC) turtle soup mysteries across 12 languages. Never returns solutions. Supports filtering by locale, source, category, difficulty (1=easy, 2=medium, 3=hard), tags, keyword query, or random sampling.

limit.description: Max puzzles to return (default 15, or 3 when random=true)

locale.description: Puzzle language code (en, zh, zh-TW, ja, ko, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru, th). Also accepts zh-CN, en-US, ja-JP.

query.description: Case-insensitive keyword search on title and scenario

random.description: When true, return random matching puzzles

source.description: Filter by source: all (official + public UGC), official, or ugc

tags.description: Filter puzzles that include all specified tags

name: ynm_search_puzzles
title: Search Lateral Thinking Puzzles
